narration: When the sidebar is open and you right-click on an element, the context menu pops open but is immediately drawn underneath the sidebar, making it unreachable. On touch devices the same menu also shows four layer-ordering options that don't belong there.
items: Right-click menu opens but is hidden behind the sidebar
On mobile or tablet, the menu shows layer-ordering items that belong to the desktop panel

narration: The problems come in a pair. First, the floating sidebar renders behind the top toolbar buttons, so buttons poke out over the panel. Second, if you open the main menu while the sidebar is showing, both stay open at the same time — on mobile the menu is drawn on top of the sidebar, leaving the sidebar unreachable behind it.
items: Toolbar buttons appear on top of the open sidebar panel
Opening the main menu leaves the sidebar and menu both visible — the menu sits on top of the sidebar on mobile

narration: Two dropdown menus in the editor — the main menu and the More Tools menu — are supposed to close when you click anywhere outside them. After a recent refactor, that stopped working. Clicking the canvas or a toolbar button leaves the menu open.
items: Clicking the canvas while a dropdown is open does not close it
Tapping a toolbar button while a dropdown is open does not close it

narration: When you select an arrow and click one of the arrowhead buttons in the properties panel, a small popup appears to pick the arrowhead style. The bug is that this popup can overflow the visible area and be partially or fully hidden off the edge of the screen. On phones the problem is most visible.
items: The arrowhead style popup extends beyond the edge of the screen
On a narrow or phone-sized screen the popup appears to the right and is clipped

narration: Several dropdown menu items carry a small coloured badge — for example the AI label on the diagram-from-text option. That badge was rendered inside the text portion of the row instead of its own dedicated position, putting it in the wrong place in the layout.
items: The "AI" badge on a menu item appears in the wrong position in the row
In the font picker, the badge for a font variant is not in its own slot

narration: When you open the hamburger menu on a tablet-sized screen, the canvas background color picker should show a strip of preset colors above a swatch button. Instead, it collapses to just a tiny button — the whole strip vanishes and the UI looks broken.
items: On a tablet, the canvas background picker in the menu shows only a single small button with no color strip
The compact sizing class is applied, hiding the top-picks row and altering the trigger's shape

narration: Drawing any shape — especially free-draw — triggers a pointer-move event for each pixel. Before this PR, each of those events caused the entire scene to repaint. On a large scene with many elements, that paint was expensive enough to feel like lag.
items: Free-draw strokes stutter on large scenes
Every pointer-move triggers a full static canvas repaint
Lag is proportional to the number of existing elements

narration: When you look at an older version of a document, the header shows how many changes it contains and lets you jump between them. According to the pull request, that counter often doesn't appear at all, and when it does, it gets stuck instead of showing which change you're on. The counter is drawn in the header, so that's where we start.
items: The counter doesn’t appear when the page loads
When it does, it stays on “N changes” instead of “2 of N”
